has measured condition

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasMeasuredCondition
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasMeasuredCondition
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/sensory-environment

An objective measurement of the ambient conditions, expressed as a CoordinateMatrix in a measurement reference frame. Non-functional: multiple instruments may produce competing measurements, and those claims coexist rather than collapse (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:SensoryEnvironment -> gmeow:CoordinateMatrix

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasMeasuredCondition from gmeow:SensoryEnvironment to gmeow:CoordinateMatrix when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
